calibrationMethod: direct parameterized shadow candidate evaluation per replay checkpoint

recommendation.why: The corrected direct grid still gives this configuration the best semantic balance: the required 89% WP CFB state reaches 50, genuine late uncertainty reaches 86/74 in CFB/NFL, strong and ordinary early states remain separated at 75/59, the decisive NFL drive remains elite at 90, and the blowout remains 1. Its 0.35 uncertainty modifier preserves more false-close separation than the second-best option without making ordinary close games elite.
recommendation.secondBestWhy: modifier-70-30-c32 is more conservative for genuinely uncertain and early states, but its larger 0.70 margin floor compresses the WP gradient. It leaves the one-sided NFL anchor at the same 59 while lowering the late-uncertain NFL, strong-early, ordinary-early, and close-CFB anchors to 72, 73, 57, and 85, so it gives up useful hierarchy without improving the false-close anchor.

limitations: Checkpoint-weighted replay rows are correlated within games.
Only full-fidelity archive states are used as named tuning anchors.
Basketball archive coverage is too small for standalone tuning conclusions.
Counterfactual final equals base because no sport-specific live situation award is supplied.
